title: Repair Rust UI Test Crates After API Removals
description: Repair the Rust UI test crates under 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui broken by API removals and the arena-registration refactor: non-compiling crates (wgpu-engine-laws, engine-scene-laws, layout-laws, raster, locale, text-splice-native), 9 failing wgpu-laws (panic-safe arena scope), 5 stale contract-conformance fixtures (with TS twin), clipboard ingress admission laws, events/mounted-layout settling, and sweep all remaining UI crates. Follows 26/11/17/FINISH-SHARED-BORDER-CONSOLIDATION-ACROSS-UI. Done = every UI Rust crate compiles its tests and passes, with a per-crate before/after table.
summary:
Every Rust crate under 🖱️ui (108) compiles its tests. 107 pass in the final sweep; the per-crate before/after table is 📊️before-after.md and the root causes are in 📋️report.md. The exception is semio-framework-text-splice-native: it passed 4/4 after its repair, then failed in the final sweep because another session's live [DEBUG] probes in 🌱️value/🛬️decode allocate inside measured turns.

Main root causes:
- The engine's layout worker birth stalled every relayout at Layout.Mount after handing over its job, and an in-flight birth was never closed. Laws can no longer lay out a Ui under a bare StepContext; UiFixture now provides step_layouts/settle_layout.
- The UI arena test scope had a 10 s real-time deadline; it is now a finite 600 s ceiling. A new law pins that a panicking law releases its arena.
- The DROP_TARGET hit test skipped drop-target stacks.
- GraphicsBackend backend-testing hooks had no defaults, so feature unification broke the backends.
- Dev-dependencies did not enable the testkit features some tests need; the engine and hosting tests only compiled with explicit --features.
- semio-ui-contract-values was over its source boundary, so its arena laws moved to its companion laws crate.
- Missing arena scopes, including a conformance hang from an unscoped, unbounded close loop. Stale laws were re-pinned to current contracts.

Agent sub-reports a1–a9 cover locale/text-splice/value receiving, engine and scene laws, layout/raster, conformance fixtures, clipboard/prepared/host, TUI shared borders, the macOS Mutex allocation in the arena registry, scene crates, and shader/metal/reconciler. With the coordinating session's approval I removed one stray [DEBUG] probe from ControlledCore::step_original.

Open, outside this ticket: 74 failing job crates tests caused by concurrent work elsewhere, non-UI users of the shared receiver driver not re-run, other sessions' [DEBUG] probes, and repo :generate failing internally.
